text: Chief Officer, there's an alarm on radar one.
Let me see. The display has frozen. It isn't working.
No, don't touch it. Radar two is working, and we're at anchor. Call the Chief Engineer, please.
Chief Engineer, this is the cadet on the bridge. Radar one has stopped. The display has frozen and the alarm has gone off.

text: The alarm went off at zero seven twenty-five. Then the display froze.
A fuse has blown. I have a spare.
OK. I've changed the fuse. Now reset it, cadet.
Reset… It's working! The display is back.
Good. Write it in the defect list. Fault, cause, repair. Short.
Diego, what's wrong with the radar?
The gyro alarm has gone off.
The fuse blew at zero six fifty.
